notes: A loading screen now shows while the app opens, then disappears when your notes are ready.

Fixed stale content: the app now always loads the newest version when online, so the new clean Settings (single Check for update, no sync server) are guaranteed to appear. You do not need to clear anything manually.
The top bar now shows Sign in when you are logged out, and your profile picture once you are signed in.
The + button and browsing categories now open note editors reliably.
Only one floating pen appears, and tapping it opens the quick capture popup whose category chips scroll so nothing is cut off.
Sessions start instantly, even offline. Press Enter or tap Start after entering book and author, and a Reading banner appears.
A cleaner interface throughout: relative dates, a search icon, friendlier empty screens, and Settings arranged into tidy cards.
